normal_strength.purpose: Inherited G1 microrelief strength; does not change shape or collision.

frame_shade.purpose: Inherited G1 frame shade, now also distinguishes existing timber rails.

end_normal_threshold.purpose: Selects cut map where the normal faces along the timber member; no endgrain blend onto long faces.

board_width_m.purpose: Inherited quarter metre D1/D3 physical board spacing; variation follows the same run across coarse/fine joins.

board_phase_texels.purpose: Adjacent physical boards shift longitudinal grain by this whole-texel step within the original 1024-pixel face tile.

face_resolution_px.purpose: Original D4 map size used to keep phase shifts on whole texels.

recess_min_m.purpose: Minimum measured inward skin depth that receives protected metal seam response.

recess_edge_guard_m.purpose: Keeps protected seam patina away from outer arrises; no added geometric seam.

door_rails_y_m.purpose: Existing D2 horizontal rail centres; material orientation follows the retained geometry.

door_rail_half_width_m.purpose: Existing D2 half width between strap grooves.

coarse_rail_width_m.purpose: Existing D1 end-rail width on cube and wall; rail grain runs horizontally.

fine_rail_width_m.purpose: Existing D3 half cube/wall rail width; does not scale texture density.

panel_frame_width_m.purpose: Existing native/D3 integral panel batten width; frame orientation only.

window_frame_width_m.purpose: Existing native/D3 opaque window frame width; no body or pane change.

seam_roughness_add.purpose: Additional roughness at protected existing metal recesses; oxide/patina remains distinct from the metal body.

projection_axis_threshold.purpose: Stabilizes near-axis broad-plane projection across existing bevel normals.

roof_face_min_up.purpose: Separates roof covering planes from cut side/underside faces.

alternate_axis_threshold.purpose: Selects a nonparallel tangent reference for end maps.

recess_face_threshold.purpose: Limits protected metal seam tint to front-facing recesses.

inspection_grid_m.purpose: Diagnostic grid pitch in metres; used only in labelled UV evidence.

inspection_line_fraction.purpose: Diagnostic grid line fraction; not enabled in normal candidate rendering.
